caseName: Williamson v. Lee Optical of Oklahoma, Inc.
caseNameFull: Williamson, Attorney General v. Lee Optical of Oklahoma, Inc. and Lee Optical of Oklahoma, Inc. v. Williamson, Attorney General

opinions.text: Appeals from the United States District Court for the Western District of Oklahoma. Probable jurisdiction noted, 348 U. S. 854. The motion for leave to file brief of Pennsylvania Optical Co., as amicus curiae, is denied.
